subject: Telemetry retention, subprocessor onboarding & evidence request
messages:
From: Alicia Morales <alicia.morales@healbridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Telemetry retention & subprocessor onboarding: evidence request

Hi Soojin / team,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG + procurement review we need a concise confirmation of how Redwood treats runtime telemetry for hosted deployments and the onboarding controls for any subprocessors that receive telemetry data. Specifically we need:

- A short table of telemetry categories (metrics, request/response metadata, debugging traces, sampled payloads) and your retention windows for each.
- Which third parties receive any telemetry (names, jurisdiction, role) and whether they have access to any request/response content or only metadata.
- Whether prompt text or user-uploaded content is ever captured in logs for the hosted API (and if so, under what customer-configured opt-in).
- The onboarding runbook / checklist you use to vet telemetry recipients (controls, attestations required, KMS residency constraints).
- Any SOC 2 / CAIQ / SIG artifacts you can provide or links to where we can securely download them.

If you can provide a short evidence bundle (CSV list of subprocessors + a small diagram of the telemetry flow) that would help us close the review. Target timeline: answers + lite evidence in 3 business days, full pack in ~7 days.

Happy to hop on a short call if needed.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Morales
Security Operations Manager, Healbridge Inc
---
Attachment requests: sample telemetry schema, subprocessor roster
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Morales <alicia.morales@healbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry retention & subprocessor onboarding: evidence request

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list. Below is a short, pragmatic summary and an attachment deliverable plan; we can expand any section you want.

Quick answers (summary):
- Retention: raw request logs (transient) are retained for 14 days by default, aggregated metrics and telemetry rollups retained for 90 days. Debug-level traces (which can include request/response snippets) are only kept when a customer explicitly enables debug capture and agree to the retention override; otherwise prompt text is not persisted.
- Subprocessors: telemetry is forwarded only to our monitoring and observability provider MetricFlow Inc (US-based) for metrics and alerting; anonymized traces are optionally routed to LogHarbor (EU) for long-term analytics by customer request. Neither provider receives customer secrets or unredacted credentials.
- Prompt text: by default, hosted API request and response bodies are not stored in long-term logs. Short-lived caches (KV cache) may hold transient data in-memory during inference; persistent capture requires explicit customer opt-in (debugging or support session).
- Onboarding runbook: we require SOC 2 attestation (or equivalent), an encryption provenance statement (KMS location + key custody), and a vulnerability scan summary. We also conduct contract-level data processing addenda and a short questionnaire mapped to SIG/CAIQ controls.

Deliverables we are attaching now (stubs):
- subprocessors_list_v3.csv (roster + country + role)
- telemetry-dataflow-diagram.png (8-bit PNG, 1 page diagram)
- runbook_telemetry_onboarding.pdf (runbook summary, 4 pages)

Timeline proposal: SIG-lite answers within 3 business days (we can do that), full evidence package including SOC 2 report links and signed attestations within 7 business days. If you need evidence earlier for a procurement gate, please flag which artifact is gating.

If helpful, I can redact example logs to show the difference between "metadata-only" and "debug capture".

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Security & Privacy Program Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: runbook_telemetry_onboarding.pdf (4 pages), subprocessors_list_v3.csv (CSV), telemetry-dataflow-diagram.png (diagram)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry retention & subprocessor onboarding: evidence request

Alicia — adding a couple of items you asked for and a link to our SOC 2 artifact.

- SOC 2: We completed our most recent SOC 2 Type II in Q2 2026. Secure download: https://drive.google.com/secure/redwood/SOC2_report_redwood_2026Q2 (access granted to your security@healbridge.com address; please let me know if you need a different email).
- CAIQ/SIG: For SIG requests we usually provide a SIG Lite + evidentiary attachments. Soojin's runbook will cover the telemetry-specific mapping; I will compile the wider CAIQ control references in the full pack.
- KMS provenance: MetricFlow uses AWS KMS in us-west-2 for key wrapping; we require subprocessors to provide KMS residency statements during onboarding.

HubSpot ticket for tracking: HS-43822 (I will attach the SOC 2 link and runbook into the ticket).

If you want a one-hour technical walk-through I can join and bring our infra lead (Jonas) to go through the end-to-end pipeline.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOC2_report_redwood_2026Q2.pdf (access-controlled)
From: Alicia Morales <alicia.morales@healbridge.com>

Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry retention & subprocessor onboarding: evidence request

Thanks Soojin / Marissa — that helps a lot. A couple follow-ups before we mark HS-43822 as closed: 

- Can you confirm the default hosted API mode does not persist prompt text to long-term storage (only transient caches)? Your note suggests that is the case but we need an explicit confirmation to include in our risk memo.
- For MetricFlow: can you send the KMS provenance statement or the onboarding questionnaire answer that confirms key location and whether MetricFlow has any key-wrapping or plaintext access?
- Timeline: can you confirm you will deliver the SIG-lite answers + the subprocessors CSV by COB Friday, 2026-07-24, and the full evidence pack (SOC2 link, signed attestation, runbook) by 2026-07-26?

If yes to the above, let's also schedule a 30-minute call on 2026-07-25 to walk the flow; proposed meeting link: https://meetings.hb/telemetry-review (or send a calendar invite).

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alicia Morales
Security Operations Manager, Healbridge Inc
